name: root-crate-git-split
body: Wave G of the multi-wave task-19 root-crate decomposition (behaviour-preserving, CLI unchanged). `src/git.rs` is decomposed into `src/git/{state,identity,commit,time}.rs` plus `src/git/mod.rs`, and the module FQN `rust.apg.git` stays. `src/git/tests.rs` stays put, so the test module FQN `rust.apg.git.tests` stays. Three durable `implemented-by` edges target the post-split FQNs: `solution.component.scan-hygiene` and `solution.component.structural-claiming` → `rust.apg.git.state.path_is_ignored`, and `solution.component.identity-layer` → `rust.apg.git.identity.repo_rel`. The module-level edges `solution.component.identity-layer` —implemented-by→ `rust.apg.git` and `solution.container.scanner-cli` —implemented-by→ `rust.apg.git` stay.
